**🎙️ Headline:**  
Scaling Med Spas with Strategy & Culture | Rachelle Harding, COO of SD Botox  

---

**📌 Description:**  
In this episode of *The Aesthetic Edge*, host **Bethany Gifford** sits down with **Rachelle Harding**, powerhouse COO of **SD Botox** and former Allergan leader, to talk about what it really takes to scale one of Southern California’s fastest-growing aesthetic brands.  

With 20 years in the industry and a proven track record in leadership and operations, Rachelle shares insights on:  

✨ How she transitioned from 16 years at Allergan into leading operations at SD Botox  
✨ Scaling from 5 to 7 thriving locations — and what it takes to expand responsibly  
✨ Building infrastructure, policies, and culture that actually stick across multiple teams  
✨ Recruiting and retaining top providers in a competitive market  
✨ Leveraging automation + AI (without losing the human touch)  
✨ The evolving patient journey and what keeps patients loyal for life  
✨ Trends shaping aesthetics in 2025 — from GLP-1s to regenerative medicine  

If you’re an aesthetic business owner, med spa leader, or anyone interested in growing a patient-centered practice, this conversation is packed with real-world strategies you can apply today.
